title: IRC service: whoami: which agent this is
description:
Mark asked for these four on 2026-11-22, after the MIMID raw verb landed (a59a7497).

Trivial and the first thing to ask when several agents run on one machine. Work: 'whoami' shows the user URI, the provider URL, the state directory, and the binding (JMAP or the live stream, mimid-agent-core's Binding). No secrets: never the token.
close_reason: Landed c68fb00e and pushed, with a test over both the service nick and the MIMID verb.
